title: ShopDef

price.description: Price per unit in currency, above 0; overrides the item's buy_price in this shop. Left out: the item's buy_price (which must then be above 0).

stock.description: The items for sale, in the order the client lists them. At least one; no item twice.

description: A shop (T-603): what an NPC's shop service sells. A dialogue opens it with an open_service action whose service is shop and whose shop_id names this definition. Players buy the items listed here, each at its Price (or, without one, the item's buy_price); players sell any carried item that has a sell_price to any shop, at that price (selling is not limited to the stock).
